fact_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
fact_list_empty: There are no active facts for this server yet.
ask_not_configured: Aura's question-answering isn't set up on this server yet. Ask a server admin to configure it.
ask_no_info: I don't have any information about that yet.
ask_error: Something went wrong while putting together an answer. Please try again in a moment.
config_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
config_no_options_error: Specify at least one of `proactive` or `extraction` to change something.
config_proactive_enabled: Proactive replies are now **on** in {channel}. Aura may volunteer an answer there when it's confident.
config_proactive_disabled: Proactive replies are now **off** in {channel}. Aura will stay silent there unless asked directly.
config_extraction_enabled: Automatic fact extraction is now **on** in {channel}. Aura may read messages there for facts to remember.
config_extraction_disabled: Automatic fact extraction is now **off** in {channel}. Aura will not read messages there for facts.
proactive_reply_label: 💡 Aura noticed a question in this channel
proactive_reply_footer: Aura volunteered this because it was confident — nobody asked it directly. A moderator can turn this off with /aura-config.
debug_signals_trail: S1 {stage1} · S2 {stage2} · Cooldown {cooldown} · Cap {cap} · Grace {grace} · Synth {synthesis}
debug_signals_verdict_ambiguous_facts: Two facts too close to call
debug_signals_empty: No question signals have been recorded for this server yet.
debug_signals_footer: Diagnostic view of Aura's proactive pipeline — this command itself never posts and is only visible to you.
debug_signals_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
supersede_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
supersede_fact_not_found: Fact #{fact_id} doesn't exist in this server.
supersede_old_already_superseded: Fact #{fact_id} is already superseded, so it can't be superseded again.
supersede_new_not_active: Fact #{fact_id} isn't currently active, so it can't be the successor of another fact.
supersede_success: Fact #{old_fact_id} is now superseded by fact #{new_fact_id}.
supersede_expired: Confirmation timed out. Nothing was changed.
supersede_wrong_user_error: Only the moderator who ran this command can confirm it.
supersede_old_race_error: Fact #{fact_id} was already superseded by someone else just now. Nothing was changed.
supersede_new_race_error: Fact #{fact_id} is no longer active (it may have just been superseded itself). Nothing was changed.
pending_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
pending_none: There are no fact candidates waiting for review.
pending_review_footer: {remaining} candidate(s) waiting. Aura suggested this automatically — it only becomes a real fact if you confirm it.
pending_similar_hint: If it replaces that fact rather than adding to it, confirm this candidate and then run /aura-supersede with old fact #{fact_id}.
pending_discarded: Candidate #{pending_id} discarded. No fact was created.
pending_race_error: Candidate #{pending_id} was already reviewed by someone else just now. Nothing was changed.
pending_expired: Review timed out. The candidate is still waiting.
pending_wrong_user_error: Only the moderator who ran this command can review this candidate.
pending_relationship_supersession: Replacement — the candidate updates that fact.
pending_relationship_complementary: Complementary — both stay true side by side.
pending_relationship_contradiction: Conflict — both cannot be true, and nothing says which one is current.
pending_relationship_independent: Unrelated — they only look similar; they are about different things.
pending_relationship_hint_supersession: If you agree: confirm this candidate, then run /aura-supersede with old fact #{fact_id} to retire it.
pending_relationship_hint_complementary: No /aura-supersede needed — confirming this candidate leaves fact #{fact_id} active beside it.
pending_relationship_hint_contradiction: Aura will not guess this one. Open both source messages and check which one still holds before you confirm or discard.
pending_relationship_hint_independent: Fact #{fact_id} is unaffected either way — the similarity was a false positive.
